fourway_formula: E[|A1 cap A2 cap A3 cap A4|] = |U1 cap U2 cap U3 cap U4| * prod_i (k_i / |U_i|)
loco_caveat: LOCO training folds share 2/3 of cohorts; independent uniform draws provide a size-only chance reference, not a dependence-calibrated hypothesis test.
pairwise_formula: E[|A cap B|] = k_a * k_b * |U_a cap U_b| / (|U_a| * |U_b|)
